name: Offside
note: Saudi sportswear brand and kit supplier (offsideksa.com); makes the kits of several RSL clubs. Kit maker of the Al-Shabab 2026-27 home kit: 'manufactured by local brand Offside' (Footy Headlines launch article, 2026-08-13), also listed as Al-Shabab's kit manufacturer for 2026/27 by 433FC, and the club's own site links its store to offsideksa.com, whose Al-Shabab section sells the 26/27 shirts. Who owns Offside is not sourced, so the sponsor stays not rated yet (leads, unverified: Arabic Wikipedia says the brand is owned by Raya Al-Tahaddi for Investment, based in Khobar; 2017 posts on the brand's own accounts name Ammar Al-Khan as the company's owner).
